title: [Hiring] Export Coordinator - Neenah, WI
description:
Hey folks,

We are seeking an Order Management & Global Logistics Specialist to support customer orders, international shipments, and day-to-day logistics operations for a global organization.

Good fit if you have the following requirements:

  • Previous experience in global logistics, transportation, shipping, order management, customer service, procurement operations, or a related field.
  • Experience working with international shipments, carriers, warehouses, or global customers is strongly preferred.
  • Previous experience in a global organization is highly desirable.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and organizational skills.
  • High attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Proactive approach to work, including the ability to identify additional tasks and opportunities to support the team without waiting for direction.
  • Ability to work effectively with customers, vendors, warehouse teams, carriers, and internal stakeholders.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Windows, Word, Excel, and SharePoint.
  • SAP and SED experience is preferred.

Performance Objectives / What you'll be doing:

  • Meet established daily shipping deadlines.
  • Provide initial customer responses within 24 hours.
  • Maintain accurate order, shipment, and export information.
  • Minimize customer service-related claims through accurate and timely order management.
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential shipping and order issues.
  • Contribute to team productivity by taking ownership of additional responsibilities and projects when appropriate.

Location: Neenah, WI
Duration: 6-month contract with possible conversion to FTE
Employment Type: Contract role on W-2 through Above and Beyond Talent Acquisition, Inc. (A&B Talent)
Work Arrangement: Onsite
US Payrate: $15.00 - $20.00

Must be authorized to work on the US.

If interested:
Email your resume and availability to [apply@aandbtalent.com](mailto:apply@aandbtalent.com)
